data.turoyo: Mətyaqən, mətyaqən, bəṯər b tloṯo yawme, mbadele aw waroqayḏe, manṭalle mu qolordi, ǧləbile w mbarele u zlamano. Əṯyo i inaniyayḏox, xla lə kumarno.
data.translation: Believe it, believe it, after three days he changed his papers; they brought them from corps headquarters, turned them over and released the man. Let your confidence come, I tell no lie.

rationale: New II Preterit box; papers, officer action and explicit human object support release without asserting medical or judicial subtype. English is the supplied project machine translation, not an edition translation; analysis rests on Turoyo.

summary: New idiom: xəd/xud bəryole l Aloho 'wie Gott sie schuf, nackt'

data.headword: xəd/xud bəryole l Aloho 'wie Gott sie schuf, nackt'
data.turoyo: xud bəryole l Aloho yo, d lo ǧule.
data.translation: sie ist so, wie Gott sie schuf, ohne Kleider.

rationale: Searches bəryo and xəd br found no entry; xlq full has no naked-as-created formula. The d lo ǧule apposition makes the idiomatic state explicit; headword is the attested feminine formula, not a fabricated paradigm.

summary: Creation is attested only in the naked-as-created formula here; the two texts corroborate the lexical distinction from release, but do not provide a full free-standing creation paradigm.

bəryo-le plausibly combines feminine patient -o- and masculine agent -le; overt l Aloho identifies the creator. bralle with plural children is contracted and its internal segmentation remains uncertain.

Do not invent an Infectum or replace the inherited brele/bore base forms. An independent homonym and etymological source require editorial work; the new numbered I.2 keeps assigned-root coverage without renumbering I.1.
II mbaratli at 27/75 concerns release from kinship, with human suffix and m- source. It is already quoted and is not duplicated.
Lookup xlq confirms another creation verb in the glossary but no existing naked-as-created formula under that root; this does not make the bry tokens xlq.
